meta.title: Kids Coding Platform
meta.description: Learn to code, build real things, get rewarded — safely, in your language.

home.title: Learn to code, build real things, get rewarded
home.subtitle: Short lessons in your child's language, real projects from day one, and a safe place to grow — built for kids aged 9 to 16.
home.safety: Parents create and approve every child account. Children appear with a nickname only — never their real name, photo or school.
home.languages: Lessons in English, Arabic and Urdu, with more languages coming.
home.build: Every module ends with a game, a website or an app your child can show to friends.

auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A short sentence works well.
